'''Kenny''' (Japanese: '''キンジ''' ''Kinji'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. He works as the [[Gym]] assistant for the [[Petalburg Gym]]. As a result, Kenny is very close to [[Norman]] and his family. 

In ''[[AG069|Love, Petalburg Style!]]'', Kenny greeted {{an|May}}, [[Max]], and {{an|Brock}} at the [[Gym]]'s entrance and joined them for a meal prepared by [[Caroline]]. However, Caroline exhibited anger at May's mention of {{p|Beautifly}}, which puzzled May, Max, and Brock. Kenny subsequently took everyone to the greenhouse and explained that Caroline felt frustrated because it was her wedding anniversary and Norman had been disappearing. Things later escalated after Caroline confronted Norman at the local [[Pokémon Center]] and announced her plans to leave the family home. Tensions then eased after Norman was revealed to have been planning a Beautifly-shaped fireworks display with [[Nurse Joy]]'s assistance to commemorate the wedding anniversary.

In ''[[AG070|Balance of Power]]'', Kenny [[Battle judge|refereed]] the Gym {{pkmn|battle}} between Norman and {{Ash}}.

Kenny reappeared in a flashback in the Japanese version of ''[[AG089|A Scare to Remember!]]''. He was last seen watching the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] on [[Television|TV]] with Norman in ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]''.
